metadata.title: The Man Accused of Breaking a Levee to Strand His Wife
metadata.description:
1993 flood overwhelmed levees across the Midwest. The cause: prolonged high water overtopping and destroying hundreds of levees.

Failure chain: Months of rain → Rivers at record → Levees overtopped → One levee sabotaged → Farmland flooded

Related episode: San Bruno: What Failed First — https://youtu.be/PAi4kSZesNE

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Great Flood of 1993 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Flood_of_1993
• NOAA — tr9304 (cited by Wikipedia) — http://www1.ncdc.noaa.gov/pub/data/documentlibrary/reports/technical/tr9304.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
